name: Unrelenting Swarm applies its aura and routes its mods to Crypt Scarabs (#2372)
contract: Unrelenting Swarm 704719 reads 'Reduces the Runic Power drained by each Crypt Scarabs tick by $/10;s1'. Its payload is already correct in Spell.dbc - two SPELL_EFFECT_APPLY_AURA (6) with aura 108 (ADD_PCT_MODIFIER), EffectMiscValue 19 (SPELLMOD_ACTIVATION_TIME, SpellDefines.h) and 1 (SPELLMOD_DURATION), base points -51 (-50%). Two code fixes make it register: AscensionNecromancerContracts.cpp marks 704719 passive so the aura applies at learn (Player::AddSpell only casts passive auras), and SpellInfo.cpp routes mod 704719 to Crypt Scarabs 805868 by named root (masks alone could never match its 0/0/0 family flags). The spell_modifier metric starts from a nonzero base because Player::ApplySpellMod skips PCT mods on a null basevalue. Open half, not asserted here: Crypt Scarabs 805868 carries only a Dummy aura, so no Runic Power drain exists to observe reduced - that needs the maintainer decision tracked in #5540. This scenario locks the aura and the routing, not the drain.

steps.label: SETUP: no Crypt Scarabs modifier before the talent
The talent aura is applied at learn (this is what the missing passive flag broke)
The activation-time mod now reaches Crypt Scarabs (this is what the missing routing broke)
The duration mod now reaches Crypt Scarabs
